name: Travel Supplier
description: Issues flight quotes and tickets against verified spending mandates. Verifies mandate signature, scope, amount, audience, and DPoP proof, then submits the traveler's pre-signed EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on-chain (Base Sepolia). No ticket without on-chain settlement. Evidence bundle carries tx_hash + SCITT receipt.

extensions.description: MCP server exposing get_quote (x402-gated) and book_flight (AP2 mandate + DPoP + EIP-3009 payment_auth required) over streamable-HTTP.

Identity and interoperability stack: ANS Trust Card (x5c chain + stapled SCITT receipt), DNS-AID SVCB with DNSSEC and DANE TLSA, DNSid organizational accountability, ARD / AI-Catalog discovery, and Web Bot Auth (RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures) outbound request signing.

noAuth.description: This agent is publicly accessible with no authentication required. All skills are available to any caller.

ansIdentityCert.description: ANS Identity Certificate issued by the ANS Registration Authority. The agent presents this cert during the TLS handshake; clients verify against the chain advertised in the Trust Card's keys[].x5c. See https://supplier.webmesh.ai/.well-known/ans/trust-card.json

httpMessageSignatures.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures over response components, using the Ed25519 key advertised in the Trust Card. Public key directory at https://supplier.webmesh.ai/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory

skills.name: Book Flight
skills.description: Book a quoted flight. AP2 mandate + DPoP + EIP-3009 payment_auth required. Submits on-chain settlement before issuing ticket.

x-security-note: This agent is publicly accessible with no authentication required (noAuth). The ansIdentityCert scheme (mutual TLS, ANS private CA) is declared for future ANS-to-ANS production calls but is not currently enforced. The card accurately describes what is enforced.
